For your gluten-free bread recipe, the best all-purpose alternative to maintain an airy structure and flavor is a high-quality **1:1 gluten-free baking flour blend** (also known as measure-for-measure or cup-for-cup flour). Look for blends that include xanthan gum or guar gum, as these binders are crucial for replicating the elasticity and air-trapping properties of gluten. Popular brands like Bob's Red Mill, King Arthur, or Cup4Cup work well. If your blend does not contain a binder, add 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan gum per cup of flour to help the loaf rise properly and avoid a crumbly texture.
